newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Port Louis Fund opens public offer.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Port Louis Fund opens public offer.

text.p: The Mauritius Port Louis Fund on Thursday opened a sale issue of 600 million rupees ($29 million) of ordinary shares aimed at achieving high income yield and long term capital growth, the fund director said.
Rajiv Beeharry told Reuters that the open-ended fund, set up in May this year, was incorporated as a public company with limited liability and having an authorised mutual fund status.

"The main objective of the Port Louis Fund is to achieve capital growth and income over long term by investing primarily in a combination of performing companies under government ownership and control, in listed equities, and in highly liquid instruments with high income yields," Beeharry said.
Minimum subscription for this issue is 60 million ordinary shares of 10.00 rupees each.
"The fund reserves the right to retain subscriptions up to an amount of 800 million rupees," Beeharry added.
Beeharry said out of the initial subscription, 200 million rupees had been privately placed. The sale issue would remain open until June 27.
The director said that the Fund had been granted a call option to buy 200 million rupees worth of shares of Mauritius Telecom on its flotation at the initial public offer price.
The fund would be managed by Capital Asset Management Ltd, with the collaboration of Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) and Emerging Markets of London.
The Port Louis Fund is the island's second country fund after the launch of Mauritius Fund in 1992.
